revisions.purpose: Release 0.3.26: on the Tc chart the five materials that opened an era (mercury 1911, La-Ba-Cu-O 1986, YBa2Cu3O7 1987, MgB2 2001, H3S 2015) are placed before any other name and their space is reserved, so their names stay on screen in bold for as long as their year has arrived and no twinkling name can land on top of them; they are allowed a wider set of offsets so they are not dropped on a narrow screen, and they are excluded from the twinkling rotation, which continues unchanged for the other 43; every dot now carries a halo that fades in and out in step with its own name, drawn as a filled glow rather than a ring because an open ring already means under high pressure, and hidden entirely under reduced motion; the detail panel adds a two-to-three sentence background for every one of the 48 materials, beside the structure animation, the measured Tc, the note and the paper; choosing a material now dismisses the hover card, which a touch screen could not dismiss by itself and which covered the neighbouring dots, and closing the panel returns focus to the chart; the arrow keys no longer reach materials the year sweep has not arrived at, a material whose family is switched off in the legend no longer stays open in the panel, and a pinned name is now counted as occupied space so a twinkling name cannot be written over it; the data, the models and the results are unchanged
